description: Source code for a Kubernetes API server controller that manages OpenAPI specifications for CustomResourceDefinitions (CRDs). It watches CRDs, constructs and merges OpenAPI schemas, and updates the OpenAPI service accordingly.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages OpenAPI schemas for CRDs, watches for CRD changes, and updates the OpenAPI service.

classes.name: specCache
classes.description: Caches the merged OpenAPI spec and CRD object for a specific CRD.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Creates a new Controller instance with CRD informer.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, initializes specs, and runs worker threads.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes the next item in the work queue.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of a CRD, updating or removing its OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: updateSpecLocked
methods.description: Merges all CRD specs and updates the OpenAPI service.

methods.name: addCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles addition of a CRD event.

methods.name: updateCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles update of a CRD event.

methods.name: deleteCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles deletion of a CRD event.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a CRD name to the work queue.

methods.name: createSpecCache
methods.description: Creates a new specCache for a given CRD.

methods.name: generateCRDHash
methods.description: Generates a hash string for a CRD based on UID and generation.
